task_groups.title: Implement processMergeJob: Full Merge Pipeline (REQ-5)

subtasks.title: Implement processMergeJob steps 1–5: CanMerge, dry-run, mutex acquire, nonce validate, set running
details: Implement processMergeJob(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, runner *gitcmd.GitRunner, job MergeJob, hook PostMergeHook) error in merge.go
Step 1: call CanMerge; route BeforeDependency/BranchNotReady/SpecBlocked to re-enqueue with backoff; AlreadyMerged to set merged; WouldConflict to set conflict
Step 2: call runDryRunConflictCheck outside mutex; on conflict set status=conflict with conflict_details
Step 3: acquire per-target-branch mutex from the mutex map
Step 4: validate nonce via ValidateNonce; skip if running/merged; discard if no record
Step 5: set status=running, record base_sha from current target HEAD

subtasks.title: Implement processMergeJob steps 6–7: fetch and rebase with conflict handling
details: Step 6: call runner.Run(ctx, "fetch", "origin", targetBranch) to update remote tracking ref
Step 7: call runner.Run(ctx, "rebase", "origin/"+targetBranch)
On rebase conflict: call runner.Run(ctx, "diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=U") to collect unmerged paths
Call runner.Run(ctx, "rebase", "--abort") after collecting paths
Set status=conflict, store paths in conflict_details, release mutex and return

subtasks.title: Implement processMergeJob steps 8–11: check command, push, merged, hook
details: Step 8: fetch CHECK_COMMAND from workspace variables; if set, execute via os/exec.CommandContext with sh -c and CHECK_TIMEOUT (default 10m); on failure set status=check_failed, store check_output, release mutex
Step 9: call runner.Run(ctx, "push", "origin", targetBranch); on failure set status=push_failed, release mutex
Step 10: set status=merged, record merged_sha, release mutex
Step 11: if campaign_id != "", call hook(ctx, job); log hook errors with merge_job_id but do not change job status
